page.overview:
Who is Mr. Thornton?

Mr. Thornton is a major character in Together Forever, the third story in Fazbear Frights 10: Friendly Face.

Mr. Thornton is a short man in his twenties with birdlike features, such as beady eyes, a pointed nose, and fine brown hair. He always wears vests and thick, black-rimmed glasses. For most of the story, Mr. Thornton wears a red-and-gold diamond-patterned sweater vest that hangs loosely over his narrow chest.

Mr. Thornton is considered geeky and nerdy. He has trouble keeping eye contact, never facing straight at the class and focusing his gaze a foot above people's heads. Jessica finds this behavior endearing in a loveable-nerd kind of way. Mr. Thornton also frequently leaves his sentences unfinished and rarely laughs.

Mr. Thornton is the robotics teacher at the high school Jessica and Brittany attend. When Brittany took notice of his habit of leaving sentences unfinished, she had jokingly suggested that he might be an animatronic with advanced programming and a minor glitch that prevented him from completing sentences. A few weeks before the homecoming dance, eight graders Mindy and Cindy joined Mr. Thornton's class due to their gifted knowledge of robotics.
